config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-billagg
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY' && ${header.mwPartnerCode} in 'KGDCL,JGTDSL,BTCL,LINK3'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.soap.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/billagg/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:billagg:v1:PayBill&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.soap.response&definiteStatuses=200&pending=true"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY' && ${header.mwPartnerCode} in 'KGDCL,JGTDSL,BTCL,LINK3'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.soap.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/billagg/v1/soap&request=soap.request.xsl&response=soap.response.xsl&soapAction=urn:billagg:v1:FetchBill&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.soap.response&definiteStatuses=200"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/billagg/v1/payments&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=400,422&pending=true"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=GET&path=/billagg/v1/payments/{reference}&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200,404&pending=true"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/billagg/v1/bills/fetch&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=400,422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/billagg/v1/payments/{reference}/reverse&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=404,422"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"

mappings.soap.request.xsl:
<xsl:stylesheet version="3.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
    xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions" xmlns:b="urn:billagg:v1" exclude-result-prefixes="fn">
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map[fn:string[@key='op'] = 'PAY']">
    <b:PayBill>
      <b:billerCode><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='billerCode']"/></b:billerCode>
      <b:billNumber><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='billNumber']"/></b:billNumber>
      <b:amount><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='amount']"/></b:amount>
      <b:reference><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='reference']"/></b:reference>
    </b:PayBill>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/fn:map" priority="-1">
    <b:FetchBill>
      <b:billerCode><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='billerCode']"/></b:billerCode>
      <b:billNumber><xsl:value-of select="fn:*[@key='billNumber']"/></b:billNumber>
    </b:FetchBill>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
mappings.soap.response.xsl:
<xsl:stylesheet version="3.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
    xmlns:b="urn:billagg:v1" xmlns:f="urn:bits:mw:soap-fault">
  <xsl:output method="json"/>
  <xsl:template match="/b:PayBillResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'PAY', 'status': string(b:status), 'paymentRef': string(b:paymentRef),
        'code': string(b:code)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/b:FetchBillResponse">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'FETCH', 'billNumber': string(b:billNumber), 'amount': string(b:amountDue),
        'dueDate': string(b:dueDate), 'billPeriod': string(b:billPeriod)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/f:fault">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'fault': string(@code), 'code': string(f:detail/b:error/b:code),
        'message': string(f:detail/b:error/b:message)}"/>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="/*" priority="-1">
    <xsl:sequence select="map{'reply': 'OTHER'}"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
